effort.shift.reason: No evidenced effort controls or task-class floor policy exist in the Rust routing catalogue.
effort.shift.effect: Moves a task-class route's effort one step along the effort ladder, never below the task class's policy minimum and only to an effort every configured model takes.
effort.shift.trade_off: -1 saves reasoning tokens where a route sits above its minimum; +1 buys depth at roughly proportional token cost.

lanes.silence_seconds.effect: Mark a provider observation silent after this many seconds without output or CPU progress; never kill it for silence.
lanes.silence_seconds.trade_off: Lower marks silence sooner; the process census and observation cadence stays unchanged.

lanes.max_concurrency.effect: Default number of lanes one batch runs at once, resolved from the base profile only; task-class values do not apply. An explicit dispatch concurrency wins.
lanes.max_concurrency.trade_off: Lower paces quota and memory and lengthens wall time; total tokens are unchanged.

context.ceiling_tokens.reason: Rust dispatch has no context-compaction path to consume a token ceiling.
context.ceiling_tokens.effect: Auto-compaction ceiling for a dispatch that names none; null keeps the catalogue's context.ceiling_tokens.
context.ceiling_tokens.trade_off: Lower compacts sooner, so each turn re-reads fewer tokens, at more risk that a long lane loses detail.

review.extra_reviewers.effect: Independent reviews added on top of the HARNESS.md ladder minimum for the tier.
review.extra_reviewers.trade_off: Each extra review costs one reviewer lane and adjudication time for wider defect coverage.

review.cross_family.effect: prefer: a blocked cross-family leg is replaced by a same-family reviewer through another lens, as the ladder allows. require: wait for, or reroute to, another family instead.
review.cross_family.trade_off: require keeps decorrelated review at the price of waiting on quota or outages.

review.rereview_scope.effect: After a repair, re-review only the repair delta, or the whole change again.
review.rereview_scope.trade_off: full catches interactions between the repair and untouched code at roughly the cost of the first review.

review.polish.effect: auto: one behaviour-preserving polish lane before review when the diff exceeds about 300 lines or touches more than one crate or package. always: every change. off: never.
review.polish.trade_off: Polish costs one writer lane per qualifying change for a simpler diff and shorter review.

repair.max_cycles.effect: The chair's stopping point for repair cycles; null uses the risk-tier budget. It can only lower the fixed ceiling.
repair.max_cycles.trade_off: Lower returns to the user sooner and spends less on repairs, at the cost of the user's attention.

council.junior_size.effect: Junior council members per part in a bottom-up tiered council.
council.junior_size.trade_off: Fewer juniors cut lens passes and tokens; more widen family spread on blind spots.

routing.pool_mode.reason: Rust routing resolves exact routes and explicit fallbacks; it has no weighted model-pool owner.
routing.pool_mode.effect: top always takes the highest-weight available model; rotate spreads picks by weight across the pool.
routing.pool_mode.trade_off: rotate spreads quota and families across models at some cost in consistency between lanes.

writing.final_polish.effect: Whether reader-facing prose may take a final voice pass by the dossier's polish model.
writing.final_polish.trade_off: off saves one writing lane per document; optional improves voice at some risk of drift the chair must diff.

context.summary_tokens.effect: Cap on a worker's returned summary; the file stays the record.
context.summary_tokens.trade_off: Smaller keeps the chair's context lean; larger carries more detail inline.

quota.pace_tolerance.reason: Rust quota computes availability and admission, not pace against a tolerance.
quota.pace_tolerance.effect: Percentage points either side of even use before a quota window reads as ahead of pace or reserve.
quota.pace_tolerance.trade_off: Lower flags pacing pressure earlier (fewer limit hits, more rerouting); higher tolerates bursts.

balanced.description: Today's behaviour: every knob at its registry default.

economy.description: Less usage per task, accepting slower runs and slightly thinner passes.

rigorous.description: Correctness first: deeper effort, more independent review, full re-review.
